tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Read the board: its spaces (Essential, projects) and channels, then one space's task trees (id, title, status, depth, due, group; no notes) and groups. Tasks nest three levels: task, microtask, nanotask.

space.description: Space id or name; default the open one.

bin.description: List that space's Recycle bin instead (ids for restore_task).

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one task: title, note, status, due date, parent, depth, space, group and direct children.

tools.name: put_task
tools.description: Create a task (no id) or edit one (with id). parent makes it a sub-task (three levels at most). children adds a whole breakdown in one call (at most 100 tasks): send each workstream as one root with all its children. Titles: verb first, 10 words or fewer; detail, commands and links in note. 3 to 7 children per task. A parent's status is derived from its children. The app lays the boxes out after every write; never send coordinates.

id.description: Edit this task; omit to create.

note.description: Detail, Markdown subset, at most 500 words.

pin.description: Show its note as a card beside the box: rules, reference, decisions.

fold.description: Fold its sub-tasks into the box (compact).

open.description: List its nanotasks inside its menu.

layout.description: How its children stand: "right" a column beside it, "below" a list hanging under it. Default: the app picks (below past 5 leaves).

note.description: Detail, Markdown subset, at most 500 words.

pin.description: Show its note as a card beside the box: rules, reference, decisions.

fold.description: Fold its sub-tasks into the box (compact).

open.description: List its nanotasks inside its menu.

layout.description: How its children stand: "right" a column beside it, "below" a list hanging under it. Default: the app picks (below past 5 leaves).

parent.description: Parent task id; null makes it a root.

space.description: Space id or name for a new root, or to move a task with its sub-tasks; default the open one.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Move a task and its sub-tasks to the Recycle bin (recoverable with restore_task). Never a hard delete.

tools.name: restore_task
tools.description: Bring a task (and its sub-tasks) back from the Recycle bin. Find ids with get_board {bin: true}.

tools.name: put_group
tools.description: Create a group (no id) or edit one: a named dashed box round root tasks of one space, filed in a channel. tasks replaces its membership; the app stacks them in the order sent, so send them in reading order.

id.description: Edit this group; omit to create.

tools.name: arrange
tools.description: Tidy boxes already on the board: a task's tree, a group (its trees stacked) or a whole space (groups side by side). Long titles wrap to two lines, children line up in columns, long lists hang below. Never needed after your own writes: they are arranged already.

target.description: A task id, a group id, or a space id or name.

style.description: "auto" (default), "tree" (every list beside its parent) or "comb" (the top task's list below it).

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Ungroup: the group goes, its tasks stay where they are.

tools.name: put_channel
tools.description: Create a channel in a space (no id) or rename one. Names are lowercase-with-dashes.

id.description: Rename this channel; omit to create.

space.description: Space id or name; default the open one.

tools.name: delete_channel
tools.description: Delete a channel; its groups read as #general.

tools.name: put_project
tools.description: Create a project space (no id) or rename one. At most 9 projects, names up to 20 characters.

id.description: Rename this project; omit to create.
